features-v2-dark.svg: VERSION: The overdrive CLI versions ~/.claude as a local git repo and pins every tool repo by SHA in one lock file. MODS: overdrive-tabs draws a tab band above the prompt. overdrive-tools colors every tool row and folds it. LOOK: An output style, a session banner and a five-row statusline share one neon palette and one art language
features-v2-light.svg: VERSION: The overdrive CLI versions ~/.claude as a local git repo and pins every tool repo by SHA in one lock file. MODS: overdrive-tabs draws a tab band above the prompt. overdrive-tools colors every tool row and folds it. LOOK: An output style, a session banner and a five-row statusline share one neon palette and one art language
what-v2-dark.svg: One version for the setup: VERSION holds the semver, overdrive.lock pins components by SHA, and every version keeps its own log. Drift on session start: A SessionStart hook checks the pins in under 150 ms and records drift in the background. Colored tool rows: INF cyan for reads, CHG magenta for changes, RUN yellow for shell and agents. Click a tag to fold or open the row. Tab band: Code, tickets, Claude usage, overdrive state and a serpent pet, in a pink box above the prompt. Session log: Every tool appends INFO, WARN and CRITICAL lines to one crash-safe log per Claude session. Trace: overdrive trace reads a finished session: tool calls, wall time and token counts per tool
what-v2-light.svg: One version for the setup: VERSION holds the semver, overdrive.lock pins components by SHA, and every version keeps its own log. Drift on session start: A SessionStart hook checks the pins in under 150 ms and records drift in the background. Colored tool rows: INF cyan for reads, CHG magenta for changes, RUN yellow for shell and agents. Click a tag to fold or open the row. Tab band: Code, tickets, Claude usage, overdrive state and a serpent pet, in a pink box above the prompt. Session log: Every tool appends INFO, WARN and CRITICAL lines to one crash-safe log per Claude session. Trace: overdrive trace reads a finished session: tool calls, wall time and token counts per tool

extras-v2-dark.svg: output-styles/overdrive.md: Copy to ~/.claude/output-styles/, then select it under Output style in /config. statusline-command.sh: Point statusLine.command in ~/.claude/settings.json at it. Chips for tools you lack stay empty. hooks/overdrive-banner.sh: A SessionStart hook: the pink banner and the frame reminder. tools/overdrive/overdrive: Link into your PATH. It expects ~/.claude to be a local git repo

cmds-v2-dark.svg: overdrive: Status: version, uncommitted changes, lock drift. Read-only. overdrive snapshot [--if-drift] ["msg"]: Regenerate the lock and commit if anything changed. overdrive bump patch|minor|major "msg": New version, new log, commit and tag. overdrive history · changelog [N]: Versions with their messages and log lines. overdrive trace [<session>|--last]: Tool calls, wall time and tokens of one session. overdrive catalog · limits: Every tool with its glyph and version. Known limits and caps. overdrive session show|path|list|rm: This session's log

tools-v2-dark.svg: /tools folded: Default. Every finished tool row starts folded. /tools changes: Fold info rows. Keep changes and runs open. /tools all: Open every row. Bare /tools toggles folded and all. click a tag: Fold or open that one row. Needs the fullscreen layout
